formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C → ∀ R : ℕ → ℕ → Prop, R = Relation.ReflTransGen (fun ra rb => ra < rb ∧ ∃ rj, rb = n + rj ∧ rj < C.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ra ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C rj).inputs) → ∀ T : ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Prop, T = (fun tt tL => ∀ Q : ℕ → List (ℕ × ℕ) → Prop, (∀ (qv qt : ℕ), qv < n → R qv qt → Q qt [(qt, qv)]) → (∀ (qj qt : ℕ) (qL1 qL2 : List (ℕ × ℕ)), qj < C.gates.length → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → R (n + qj) qt → Q ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).inputs.getD 0 0) qL1 → Q ((PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C qj).inputs.getD 1 0) qL2 → Q qt (qL1 ++ qL2)) → Q tt tL) → ∀ (top : ℕ) (L : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (z : Fin n → Bool), T top L → (∀ gv ∈ L, (C.wires (List.ofFn z)).getD (gv.1) false = true) → (C.wires (List.ofFn z)).getD (top) false = true)
plain_statement: It is false that: Take an AND/OR circuit, each gate reading exactly two earlier wires. A skeleton tree hanging from wire t is built by two rules: an input wire v with an OR-only path (each step an OR gate reading the earlier wire) from v to t is a leaf with leaf gate t and variable v; an AND gate j with an OR-only path from its wire to t, with a skeleton tree hanging from each of its two inputs, joins their leaf lists. If an input makes every leaf gate of a skeleton tree hanging from t true, it makes wire t true.
title: It is false that: Transversal lemma: an input making every leaf gate of a skeleton tree true makes its hanging wire true (fan-in-two AND/OR circuits)
